 The Honourable Sri Justice J.Sreenivas Rao

entities.text: Pinnamaneni Ram Prasad, vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When the matter was taken up for consideration on 04.03.2025, there was no representation for the petitioners.
To give one opportunity the matter was posted to 06.03.2025.

On 06.03.2025 also,
there was no representation for the petitioners.
To give final opportunity the matter was posted to 07.03.2025, under the caption "For Dismissal".
Even today also there is no representation for the petitioners, either physically or virtually.

2. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, basing upon the instructions furnished by the Concerned Officer, submitted that the cause in the writ petition does not survive,
on the ground that the petitioners have filed the present writ petition questioning the notification issued by the respondent authorities, under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for brevity 'Act 30 of 2013') and subsequently, respondent authorities have proceeded further as per the Act 30 of 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. From perusal of the record, it reveals that this Court ordered notice before admission on 08.09.2016 and has not granted any interim order.

4. As per the submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition,
pursuant to the notification, respondent authorities have proceeded further as per the Act 30 of 2013.
Hence, this Court is of the considered view that the cause in the writ petition does not survive for adjudication.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioners to avail the remedies as available under law.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

J. SREENIVAS RAO, J Date: 07.03.2025 vsl Pinnamaneni Ram Prasad, vs State Of Telangana, on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48399035/
